def: properly, entangled, i.e. by implication (intransitively) a snare, or (transitive) a snarer

occurrences.text: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
